title: Pre-declared hypothesis grid and final classification
transform: Projection: test_id, feature, outcome, predicted_sign, bp, p_dk, bh_adj_p, bh_sig_q10 from the v2 grid; final_classification merged one-to-one from the canonical headline set.
rounding: bp 3 dp; p/q 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor; counts not present.
footnotes: bp = basis points per 1 TRAIN-fold standard deviation of the feature. DK = Driscoll-Kraay (bw=5). BH q = Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p over the family of 10. Positive/negative signs are the pre-declared direction; H6 was declared ambiguous.

title: Canonical headline preview
transform: Projection: eight brief columns from the 11-column canonical headline set.
rounding: beta 3 dp; p 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor.
footnotes: RW = Romano-Wolf stepdown p (B=999, family of 10); wild bootstrap = entity-clustered wild cluster bootstrap p (symbol clusters, B=999). Full 11-column version is Table 5.3.

title: Economic magnitude versus the declared cost floor
transform: Projection: eight columns from economic_magnitude.csv; no annualisation and no new cost calculation.
rounding: effect 3 dp; multiples 2 dp; cost floor integer bp.
footnotes: Cost floor = 30-50 bp round-trip explicit cost, a floor that excludes brokerage, bid-ask spread and CNS carry. Effects are at 1 TRAIN-SD of the feature. H4 is opposite-sign post hoc.

title: Design summary
transform: Manual transcription of design constants already stated in the frozen plans and the v2 grid.
rounding: Counts as integers; no statistical quantity is recomputed.
footnotes: This table is a typeset index of declared design choices. The binding sources remain docs/analysis_plan.md and docs/analysis_plan_v2_extension.md.

title: Pre-declaration and freeze timeline
transform: Manual timeline transcription from the frozen plan headers, experiment register and deviation log.
rounding: Dates as ISO-8601 where known.
footnotes: The timeline is chronological, not a claim of priority over the experiment register. EXP rows are authoritative for experiment dates.

title: Anchored walk-forward folds and out-of-sample counts
transform: Projection: fold_id, mode, universe counts/dates and OOS event counts from the frozen scoring summary.
rounding: counts integer; threshold and share 4 dp.
footnotes: The q90 threshold is fitted on TRAIN rows only. Fold 0 is the warm-up train chunk and is never tested; the four scored folds are 0-3 in the source table's test rows. 12 unique symbols appear across the four fold universes. 2023-02-16 is excluded from ordering-dependent features.

title: Feature and outcome dictionary
transform: Verbatim copy of the 13-row feature dictionary with the malformed final field of the reciprocity row correctly quoted. No definition, formula or note is edited.
rounding: Text only; no numeric rounding.
footnotes: Source line 4 is not valid CSV as committed (an unquoted comma in `notes`). The print copy quotes that field only; the audited source is left untouched. `self_loop_ratio` is a self-loop volume share, not a wash-trading measure.

title: Estimator and inference matrix
transform: Manual transcription of estimator roles and decision rules from the frozen plans and register.
rounding: Alpha/q values as declared.
footnotes: DK is primary. DC-v2, FM and WB are concordance checks. RW is the v2 family-wise gate; BH is retained as the v1 gate. WB has only 12 symbol clusters.

title: Event-study and robustness protocol matrix
transform: Manual transcription of protocol names, declared variants and verdicts from the frozen plans and register.
rounding: Statistics as reported in the cited EXP rows.
footnotes: Verdicts are summaries of registered results, not new tests. The event-study p-values remain upper bounds because 68.2% of events share a date.

title: Stage-6 clean-rebuild steps and timings
transform: Projection: ordered step, script, duration and exit code from the local Stage-6 timing log. Step order is the driver's ordered STEPS list.
rounding: Duration 1 dp; exit code integer.
footnotes: The timing log is local evidence and is gitignored; this CSV is the tracked print projection. Total wall time was 3,749.9 s (62.5 min), 21/21 steps exit 0. No step was re-run to make this table.

title: Source and licence matrix
transform: Manual transcription of the live licence review into a six-source matrix; every quoted status is traceable to reports/licence_review.md.
rounding: Text only; no numeric rounding.
footnotes: Dataset and repository licences retrieved 2026-11-13T10:21:13Z; the upstream NEPSE Alpha terms were retrieved 2026-11-14T09:12:54Z and grant no explicit redistribution right (reports/licence_review.md §10). The Kaggle tier1 metadata declares MIT, while upstream clearance remains UNCERTAIN. The provenance manifest remains authoritative per file.

title: Corpus quality audit summary
transform: Transcription of counts already reported in the Ch.4 handoff pack and experiment register; no audit is re-run.
rounding: Counts as plain integers; no thousands separators.
footnotes: Counts are exact integers. 'Low-activity' means fewer than 100 trades on a symbol-day and is not an exclusion. The defect day remains in level aggregates but is excluded from ordering-dependent features.

title: Volume reconciliation summary
transform: Descriptive summary of the frozen reconciliation table: counts, median ratios and band shares. No estimate or test is recomputed.
rounding: Ratios 4 dp; counts integer; maximum ratio 3 dp.
footnotes: The ~2x full-market ratio is a 100/530 tier1 coverage artifact, not double counting. The top-12 median ratio of 1.0000 verifies buyer-side volume counting.

title: Universe selection ranking
transform: Projection: all 50 ranked candidates with role and coverage.
rounding: Turnover 0 dp; coverage 4 dp.
footnotes: Selection is TRAIN-fold turnover with a >=90% coverage rule (DC1/DC2). Ranks 1-10 are the headline universe; 11-15 are the external replication tier; the remainder are reserves.

title: Universe exclusions
transform: Projection: all 24 excluded symbols with coverage and declared reason.
rounding: Turnover 0 dp; coverage 4 dp.
footnotes: All exclusions are the pre-declared DC2 coverage rule (<90% of sessions). No symbol is excluded on the outcome or on a result.

title: Clean-rebuild drift summary
transform: Group-by summary of the frozen 73-artifact drift audit; no rebuild is re-run.
rounding: Counts integer; max differences scientific notation with 2 significant digits.
footnotes: Largest relative drift among the 25 NUMERIC_EPSILON artifacts is 2.03e-12 (broker_id_defect_sensitivity.csv); among the regression-table subset it is 3.55e-14. Anchored classifications are unchanged.

title: Clean-rebuild drift audit, artifact detail
transform: Projection: 73 artifact rows with 12-hex hash prefixes for print; full hashes remain in the source artifact.
rounding: Hashes truncated to 12 hex characters; differences scientific notation with 2 significant digits.
footnotes: Use the source artifact for full 64-character hashes. Reorder-only and drift rows are retained, not hidden.

title: Sample, folds and effective N
transform: Projection: per-hypothesis sample counts and effective N from the v2 governance grid.
rounding: Counts integer.
footnotes: n_effective = n_obs - (n_stocks - 1) - (n_dates - 1) = 7,116 - 11 - 722 = 6,383. FM cross-sections vary 712-714 because each date slice must clear the full-rank guard. The 10 rows lost from 7,126 OOS rows are missing outcome/feature rows.

title: Main hypothesis grid
transform: Projection: frozen v1 estimates plus v2 governance columns from hypothesis_grid_results_v2.csv.
rounding: bp 3 dp; p/q 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor; placebo share 3 dp.
footnotes: bp = per 1 TRAIN-SD of the feature. DK is primary; FM is a concordance check. BH q=.10 is the v1 gate. Placebo shares apply only to H2/H3 by declaration; a blank cell is not applicable. 'Sign agrees' is blank for H6 because its direction was declared ambiguous.

title: Canonical final headline set
transform: Projection: all 11 canonical columns, formatted for print.
rounding: beta 3 dp; p 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor; flags yes/no.
footnotes: H10 is the sole HEADLINE_MODERATE. H4 is EXPLORATORY_POST_HOC (opposite sign to pre-declaration). H6/H7/H8 are NULL_FRAGILE. H1/H2/H3/H5/H9 are NULL_POWERED. survives_liquidity = p<.10 under the three liquidity controls; survives_egarch = sign match AND p<.10.

title: Event-study inference
transform: Projection: all 12 rows; CAR and SD converted from decimal returns to basis points (x10,000).
rounding: CAR 3 dp in bp; test statistic 3 dp; p 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor.
footnotes: 686 events on 393 dates; 468 events (68.2%) share a date, so event-level p-values are upper bounds. The market-adjusted mean is a pre-window-alpha artifact, not an event effect. The 16-event illiquid appendix is not a headline.

title: Robustness battery survival
transform: Projection: all 46 variant-by-headline rows from the frozen survival table.
rounding: bp 3 dp; p 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor; flags yes/no.
footnotes: Variants include horizons, leave-one-stock-out, drop-bubble, external top-5 and alternative EoD thresholds. BH is evaluated within each variant family as declared; this is not a new multiplicity family.

title: Inference concordance across v2 checks
transform: Merge of four frozen tables on test_id: base grid; four-estimator concordance and Romano-Wolf; three-control liquidity specification; primary EGARCH outcome (full sample). No estimate is recomputed.
rounding: bp 3 dp; p 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor; n integer; EGARCH beta 4 dp; liquidity percent change 2 dp.
footnotes: DK = Driscoll-Kraay bw=5; DC-v2 = two-way cluster; FM = Fama-MacBeth; WB = wild cluster bootstrap (symbol clusters, B=999); RW = Romano-Wolf stepdown (B=999). Liquidity columns use the three-control single-feature specification; EGARCH uses the primary symmetric EGARCH(1,1) outcome on the full sample and is expressed in outcome-SD units per feature-SD. 'Survives' flags are the frozen columns, not new gates.

title: Quantile tail estimates
transform: Projection: five quantile points, ratio and tail labels from the frozen quantile summary; rows sorted by hypothesis number.
rounding: bp 3 dp; p 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor; ratio 3 dp.
footnotes: Quantile standard errors are Koenker heteroskedasticity-robust, not cluster-robust; panel dependence is a limitation. The 20 extreme-tail checks are unadjusted for multiplicity, so null-tail labels are descriptive only. H10: +3.083 bp at tau=.10 to +18.696 bp at tau=.90, ratio 6.064, both tails increasing.

title: Trade-size heterogeneity, primary specification
transform: Projection: 18 primary-specification rows (2 hypotheses x 3 metrics x 3 buckets); sensitivity min-1/min-10 rows omitted from the print copy but retained in the source.
rounding: bp 3 dp; p 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor; n integer.
footnotes: Buckets use TRAIN-fold p10/p90 trade size per (fold, symbol) with a minimum-5-trades guard. The sign-aware criterion is the honest adjudication: only H7 EoD large-ticket passes. The small bucket is only 0.35% of volume.

title: H7 specification-curve summary
transform: Projection: overall and outcome-split summary rows from the frozen specification curve; the 144-row curve itself is Appendix material.
rounding: bp 3 dp; shares 3 dp; robustness ratio 2 dp (absolute value).
footnotes: 144 executed specifications / 72 unique design betas. H7 is 72/72 positive for abs_ret but 66/72 negative for ret; the 1% EoD cutoff collapses the CI-exclusion share to zero. This is a volatility/absolute-return association, not a directional-return effect.

title: Subgroup heterogeneity grid
transform: Projection: all 40 rows including the four NOT_EXECUTED circuit-breaker rows. No cell is dropped or re-labelled.
rounding: bp 3 dp; p 4 dp with '<0.0001' floor; n integer.
footnotes: 36 estimated cells/interactions plus 4 NOT_EXECUTED circuit-breaker rows. No Bonferroni survivor; minimum p_bonf .1434 (H10 bottom-7). The circuit-breaker split is not implementable: no limit-hit flag exists in the corpus or verified archives.

title: Economic magnitude versus the cost floor
transform: Projection: all nine columns from the frozen economic-magnitude table.
rounding: effect 3 dp; multiples 2 dp; cost floor integer bp.
footnotes: Declared floor = 30-50 bp round-trip explicit cost, excluding brokerage, bid-ask spread and CNS carry. At 1 SD of engagement none is standalone tradable. H4 is opposite-sign post hoc.
